تستهلون (form X)
# تَسْتَهِلُّونَ (tastahillūna) /tas.ta.hil.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# تُسْتَهَلُّونَ (tustahallūna) /tus.ta.hal.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
